rationale: C09 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both memoranda concern proposed bilateral agreements for atomic-energy cooperation for mutual defense and use the same progression: recommendation to approve; finding that the partner makes substantial and material contributions to mutual defense; description of cooperation subject to provisions, conditions, guarantees, terms, and special determinations; consideration of safeguards and agreement terms; enumerated presidential approvals and the statutory risk determination; authorization of execution by the Secretary of State; submission to Congress after execution; and forwarding a copy to the Secretary of State. C03 and C10 share important statutory language and approval machinery, but their letter format and operative sequence are less closely aligned with the child.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Federal Republic of Germany is participating with the United States in an international arrangement pursuant to which it is making substantial and material contributions to the mutual defense and security.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the United Kingdom is participating with the United States in international arrangements pursuant to which it is making Substantial and material contributions to the mutual defense and security
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive shared factual predicate, adapted from the United Kingdom to Germany.

shared_material.child_excerpt: subject to provisions, conditions, guarantees, terms, and special determinations, which are most appropriate in this important area of mutual assistance
shared_material.parent_excerpt: subject to provisions, conditions, guaranties, terms, and special determinations, which are most appropriate in this important area of mutual assistance
shared_material.explanation: Nearly verbatim and distinctive language describing the controls governing cooperation.

shared_material.parent_excerpt: Having considered the cooperation provided for in the Agreement, including your joint recommendation, security safeguards and other terms and conditions of the Agreement, I hereby
shared_material.explanation: Near-verbatim transition into the operative presidential actions.

shared_material.parent_excerpt: Determine that the performance of this Agreement will promote and will not constitute an unreasonable risk to the common defense and security of the United States

After execution of the Agreement, I shall submit it to the Congress. I am forwarding a copy of this memorandum to the Secretary of State.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Approve the proposed Agreement for Cooperation; and Authorize the execution of the proposed Agreement for the Government of the United States by the Secretary of State. After execution of the Agreement, I shall submit it to the Congress. I am forwarding a copy of this memorandum to the Secretary of State.
shared_material.explanation: The closing legal and administrative machinery is substantially identical and appears in the same order.
